title: A scheme as its representable algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $T\to S$ be a scheme over $S$. Regard $T$ as an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] by the representable sheaf $h_T$ on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site], where $h_T(V)=\operatorname{Mor}_S(V,T)$ and restriction is precomposition. Its diagonal is represented by scheme fibre products, and the identity $h_T\to h_T$ is a surjective etale scheme atlas. Thus this construction retains the actual Yoneda representable sheaf, endowed with its algebraic-space property.
